mods.name: BetterLoadouts
mods.teaser: makes equipment loadout presets partial-apply instead of full-replace.

mods.name: Map Editor Lite
mods.teaser: Map Editor Lite is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create and share custom map content - using an in-raid editor and simple JSON packs, no programming required.

mods.name: Convoy
mods.teaser: the client side companion app for quartermaster

mods.name: Map Progression
mods.teaser: Unlock maps based on your progress into the game. Start out with just Ground Zero. Fully configurable!

mods.name: BreakContact
mods.teaser: Everything you always wanted in SPT

mods.name: Kill&Bill - Quest Condition Overhaul
mods.teaser: Turns existing quests into kill, dogtag, or money handover objectives while preserving quest chains, traders, and rewards.

mods.name: MoreQuickSlots
mods.teaser: When you simply can't decide - Increases the number of freely assignable quick slots by up to 6 additional slots

mods.name: DPX Melee Case
mods.teaser: A custom configurable storage case dedicated exclusively to melee weapons.

mods.name: LMSP - Let Me Switch Plates
mods.teaser: Switch plates without removing your equipped armor / rig in raid, FIKA compatible

mods.name: ODIN - THE MERCENARY
mods.teaser: The legendary, barely beatable mercenary is back.

mods.name: Trash Talk
mods.teaser: The PMC that killed you just texted. Now you can text back. TrashTalk gives every PMC killer/victim message a real AI-generated voice — reply to them, get answers based on what you said, and enjoy the beef. Local LLM or your own API key.

mods.name: The Quartermaster
mods.teaser: A global, player-driven second-hand marketplace. Sell gear from your stash. Buy gear that other players have sold. Every item has a history.

mods.name: Deadly Gas (realistic extract)
mods.teaser: More realistic end of raid - survive the gas after the timer runs out ! Use gas mask to stay longer !

mods.name: Pre 12.12 Recoil Patch
mods.teaser: Remember when recoil was something you actually enjoyed? When the gun kicked realistically, and landing the burst meant you'd earned it? Pre-12.12 Recoil puts that back.

mods.name: Wedge
mods.teaser: Every boss in Tarkov sits in his room and waits for you to come to him. You learn his corner, you clear it on your terms, you move on. Wedge doesn't wait. Wedge is already walking toward you, and he didn't come alone.

mods.name: Raiders Vs Rogues
mods.teaser: In a world of uncertainty, you can never be sure what you'll come across next. In true Tarkov fashion, Rogues and Raiders are now roaming the entire region. New brains

mods.name: AC's Stat Delta Preview
mods.teaser: Stop buying attachments just to find out what they do. Hover a weapon mod and see its real stat impact before you install it.

mods.name: AC's Attachment Compatibility Highlight
mods.teaser: Hover a part and Tarkov shows you where it belongs

mods.name: TraderSearch
mods.teaser: The search bar the trader window always lacked - filter trader stock live by item name

mods.teaser: Are you tired of going in to a raid blind? Do you want to know who Nikita is sending to prevent you from extracting? Well welcome Bot Census!

mods.name: Transits Count
mods.teaser: Because BSG does what BSG does and doesn't update everything. Make transits count.

mods.teaser: In-game local music player for SPT

mods.name: Dynamic Raid Events
mods.teaser: Transform every raid with randomized events, boss encounters, loot surges, and dynamic AI scenarios.

mods.name: Blackout
mods.teaser: Recreates the live EFT Blackout event on Labs. The power dies, the facility goes dark, and you take on the Wedge and his Black Division guards by flashlight. Real darkness, extract lockdown, keypad code doors, and a boss with his live MP7 loadout.

mods.name: Ultimate Flea
mods.teaser: Full flea control for SPT 4.1: manage the item pool, set prices, pull Tarkov.dev averages, and run a local supply/demand economy with early-wipe scaling.

mods.name: Custom UI Sounds
mods.teaser: Swap the in-game UI Audio to a custom soundpack

mods.name: Nemesis Protocol
mods.teaser: Nemesis Protocol turns ordinary PMC encounters into a persistent rivalry that develops across multiple raids.  Instead of every enemy PMC being a disposable, randomly generated opponent, the mod creates a recurring rival.

mods.name: Restricted Backpack
mods.teaser: Adds a realistic challenge to backpacks

mods.name: Infinite Loading Fix (Profile & Traders)
mods.teaser: Profile stuck on loading forever? Traders opening empty? Both come from the same race: the game builds the menu before its data arrives. This mod waits for it instead of breaking. One file, no server mod, no profile edits, nothing to configure.

mods.name: SPT Mod Manager
mods.teaser: Open-source mod manager for SPT featuring easy installation, management and Forge integration.

mods.name: True Valday
mods.teaser: The Valday PS-320 used to be clean glass, then the optics rework filled it with a shadow that swims every time you move. True Valday hands the old sight picture back.

mods.name: Universal Sensitivity
mods.teaser: Tarkov turns your mouse down every time you sprint, jump, crouch or go prone — and never tells you. One sensitivity, everywhere, with free look finally on your mouse instead of the engine's.

mods.name: Resound
mods.teaser: a mod swapping a few guns to sounds from other games mainly black ops 2

mods.name: Dev Tools
mods.teaser: A testing kit for mod work: stand in the fire while you read your logs, mag-dump without reloading, and watch every bot on the map through the walls. For building mods, not for beating raids.

mods.name: FieldKit - Dev Toolkit, Weapon Control, Loot/Entity Browser, Spawning & ESP

mods.name: Raid Settings Skipper
mods.teaser: Skips the raid settings screen when fika server settings are disabled.

mods.name: CineKit — Freecam, Cinematic Camera, Point Path Editor & Follower

mods.name: Operator Registry
mods.teaser: A shared community identity system, dog tags use real player names and levels from other mod users.

mods.name: WTT - DoomArcade
mods.teaser: Experience hell on earth... in your hideout?

mods.teaser: Lets mods show HTML panels and click-through HUDs over the game
